summary: Shows tagging a block to apply a tag to a group of tasks, and warns tag selection overrides block error handling: untagged rescue/always sections won't run when selecting only the tagged task.
questions: How do I tag a group of tasks at once?
Why doesn't my rescue section run when I use --tags?
Do tags on a block apply to rescue and always?

answer_card.title: Tagging blocks
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: ntp tasks
  tags: ntp
  block:
  - name: Install ntp
    ansible.builtin.yum:
      name: ntp
  - name: Configure ntp
    ansible.builtin.template:
      src: ntp.conf.j2
      dest: /etc/ntp.conf
```

Tag selection beats block error handling: if only a task in `block` is tagged, running with `--tags example` skips the untagged `rescue` and `always` sections.
